summary: Relay Therapeutics filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market (ATM) common stock offering of up to $212,978,049 through sales agent TD Cowen, under its existing sales agreement. As of August 3, 2026, the company had already issued 16,006,569 shares under the original agreement, with about $87 million remaining eligible. The offering is a routine capital-raising transaction, not a special situation, as it involves standard equity issuance at market prices with a 3% commission. No terms of a special-situations category are present.
